instructor: Jiatao Gu (TAs: Mutian Tong, Yong-Hyun Park, Enxin Song, Xinyue Ai)
topics: World Models Overview
History, Foundations, Probabilistic Formulation
Environments, Simulators, Rollouts
State Space Models (LGSSM, Kalman filtering, belief-state inference)
Self-supervised Representation Learning (contrastive, JEPA, masked latent prediction)
Latent-Variable and Adversarial Models (VAE, ELBO, GAN)
Latent World Models (World Models 2018, autoregressive prediction, action conditioning)
Planning and Control with World Models (MPC, CEM, MPPI)
Policy and Value Learning with World Models (Dreamer, TD-MPC, model bias)
Diffusion and Flow Matching
Video World Models (generation, prediction, interaction, long-horizon rollouts, drift)
Normalizing and Autoregressive Flows (TARFlow, STARFlow)
Spatial World Models (3D representations, radiance fields, Gaussians)
4D Dynamics and Interaction (scene flow, dynamic occupancy, contact)
Neural Physics and Learned Physical Dynamics (graph networks, neural operators)
Robot Learning (sim-to-real, domain randomization, system identification)
Vision-Language-Action and World-Action Models
LLMs as World Models (simulation, state tracking, grounding)
Reasoning Models (deliberation, recurrence, test-time computation)
World Models for Digital Agents (games, GUIs, software, multi-agent)
Evaluating World Models (utility, robustness, calibration, OOD, drift, open problems)
